title: mmt-plugin run --json result, schema_version 1
description: The result of run (#103): the plugin over a capture. Paths are relative to the project when inside it (POSIX separators), absolute otherwise. stages are always the three, in order; a stage the run did not reach is skipped. The counts are those of the frames processed before the run stopped (a capture broken after its header stops it, model.bad-pcap). stats holds the only timings; everything else is the same on a re-run with the same inputs.

profile.description: The SDK profile the plugin is generated for.

build_dir.description: The directory of mmtp_<label>.so; the runner is in its run/ subdirectory.

format.description: null when the capture was not opened.

linktype.description: The LINKTYPE_* of the first frame, which the handler reads; null when no frame was read.

dry_run.description: --dry-run: the inputs were checked and whether the plugin is up to date; nothing was compiled or run.

status.description: stale: build with --no-deps or --dry-run, when the plugin is not up to date.

plugins.description: The file names of the plugin directory the runner loaded, in mmt-dpi's load order (C locale): the SDK's plugins, the plugin and each --plugin. Empty when the capture stage did not start.

skipped.description: Frames of another link type than the first (test.other-linktype), and frames packet_process() refused.

classified.description: The packets whose protocol path has the plugin's protocol.

protocols.description: The plugin's protocol, then each --protocol, in order.

name.description: The registered name; for a --protocol no plugin registers, the name as given.

id.description: null: no loaded plugin registers it (test.unknown-protocol).

packets.description: The packets whose protocol path has it.

attributes.description: Every attribute the protocol registers, in mmt-dpi's order.

type.description: The data type it registered with (MMT_U8_DATA, ...).

packets.description: The packets in which mmt-dpi extracted it.

paths.description: The protocol paths mmt-dpi gave the packets, the most packets first (then by path); at most 1024, the packets of the others in paths_other.

path.description: The protocol names, dot-separated, e.g. ethernet.ip.tcp.http.

paths_other.description: The packets of paths beyond the 1024 kept.
